sql: select series, strike_type, count(*) as n_rows, count(trailing_move_15m) as n_move, count(distinct event_ticker) as n_events, count(distinct market_ticker) as n_mkts, min(captured_at) as first_at, min(captured_at) filter (where trailing_move_15m is not null) as first_move_at, max(captured_at) as last_at, round(avg(yes_ask_cents-yes_bid_cents)::numeric,2) as avg_spread, round(avg(minutes_to_close)::numeric,1) as avg_mtc from crypto_ladder_snapshots group by 1,2 order by 3 desc
